Package com.simpfi.config

Class Constants

java.lang.Object
com.simpfi.config.Constants
public class Constants extends Object
Defines fixed values for file paths and drawing properties to ensure consistency when plotting maps and running programs. These values are not allowed to be changed in the program and can only be altered here.
